description: Read one list and report each pick's details status. The capture read-back check; use the exact slug returned by create_list or list_my_lists.

format.description: How to render the reply text. 'text' (default): numbered rows, one field per line, best for reading the list yourself. 'markdown': linked bold titles and quoted notes, for relaying the list to the user as-is.

list.description: Exact returned slug, handle/slug, title, or id.

name: get_list_items
title: Read a list's picks
